answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using remote hardware attestation. Nodes must run inside certified secure enclaves, publishing cryptographic proofs anchored to an umber silicon root. Network validators organize these verified keys into an identity orchard, proving each agent ties to distinct physical hardware. An adversary must purchase scarce physical microchips for each agent in their rogue grove. However, this creates hardware vendor lock-in and risks side-channel exploits.
